main_body: Flat sand ground patch (64x48 area shown as a sand strip), a terrain tile with no standing volume
top_band: none - flat ground texture, no top/front structure; a single column shows sand tones with scattered speckles
evidence: The candidate is a ground surface patch, so the 3/4 top-plus-front-face contract does not apply. It is a flat sand ground with speckles and a small grey stone and a red cross-shaped marker. It has no standing volume that would need a top band or front face, and it is not an elevation. It is accepted as terrain.

style.evidence: The sand patch uses roughly 3 tan tones (light base, mid speckles, darker brown flecks) plus a grey stone and a red marker. The speckles are sparse and scattered at 1-2 px, and large areas stay as one base colour. The grass reference has clumps in several greens and the paving has stones shaded one by one, with highlights and dark joins. The candidate's tiles probably carry only about 3-5 colours each, which is well below the reference's richness. It also shows no tufts, ripple grain or pebble clusters to bring the sand to the reference level.
